check_name: Schemas that contain tables named orders / customers
Delivery / shipping date versus return date
expected: orders has only order_date; there is no shipped or delivered date
order_items has no shipped_quantity; status "Partially Fulfilled" cannot be verified

check_name: Customer owner (account manager) versus order manager
expected: customers has no salesperson_id (only the ERD image shows it); manager is stored per order

check_name: Order total versus sum of lines
expected: orders has no stored total; totals are always derived from order_items
no currency column in the schema (the ERD shows orders.currency)

check_name: Price history / price at the date of sale versus product price
expected: products has one price only; B7.16 compares the line price with the current list price
returns has no status column (the ERD shows one)
no VAT columns; prices are treated as net amounts

check_name: Discount percentage as a stored value
expected: the schema stores discount_amount (a LINE total), not a percentage; B7.10 derives the percentage
